purpose: Name the shared actor-VM selector that distinguishes animation-stream and movement-stream dispatch.

consumers.name: ActorVM_ClearAnimationOrMovementCursor
consumers.effect: Selects the actor record cursor field associated with the VM command domain.

consumers.name: ActorVM_SetStreamTimerAndLoop
consumers.effect: Selects animation or movement timer, stream cursor, and loop fields.

evidence: Exact AnimationVM and MovementVM pass initializers
conclusion: FF7DA2 is the actor-VM movement-domain selector; zero selects animation state and nonzero selects movement state.
